title: Ground States of a Transversely Confined Polaron: Uniqueness and an Explicit Limiting Profile
summary: We study minimizers of the Pekar functional with a transverse harmonic potential, which models a polaron harmonically trapped in the transverse plane but free along the longitudinal direction. For any confinement strength $Ω>0$, minimizers exist and, up to a translation along the $x_3$-direction, are radially decreasing in $(x_1,x_2)$ and symmetric decreasing in $x_3$. For small $Ω>0$ we prove uniqueness up to these symmetries.
